cv.name: PHAM BUI NAM PHUONG
cv.location: Tam Phu District, HCM City, Viet Nam
cv.summary: A dedicated Information Technology Engineer with deep expertise in full-stack development, microservices architecture, and system integration to drive scalable enterprise solutions. Proven ability to architect resilient backend systems, ensure robust data quality, and optimize application performance. Adept at bridging complex technical implementations with business objectives to deliver seamless user experiences and maintain high system reliability under heavy workloads.

bullets.description: A large-scale CRM/CMS enterprise platform requiring high availability and seamless data flow across internal departments.
items: - Maintained and expanded core backend functionalities using **C#** and **.NET Core**, implementing **microservices** with **Node.js** to enable real-time chat and automated pipelines, reducing data synchronization delays.
- Engineered responsive user interfaces and robust **data validation** layers using **Angular**, ensuring strict data consistency and boundary control before backend processing.
- Integrated **RabbitMQ** message queues to offload heavy background operations and job workers, significantly improving the main thread's response time and overall system **scalability**.
- Standardized relational database structures and optimized complex SQL joins, ensuring stable platform performance and reliable forecasting capabilities under high-volume traffic.

bullets.description: The NEEC platform and ecosystem, including hardware-integrated monitoring systems for factory operations.
items: - Designed and standardized RESTful web services using **Node.js** and Prisma, ensuring seamless integration across the NEEC ecosystem and third-party services.

- Developed highly responsive web-based dashboards using **Vue 3** to process and display real-time statuses from factory hardware, empowering the operations team to forecast issues and control equipment efficiency.
- Administered relational database architectures to enforce strict data integrity and structured integration across distributed modules.
- Managed local environments and automated CI/CD deployments via Plesk, effectively reducing manual deployment overhead and risk of configuration drift.

bullets.description: An experimental AI system architecture utilizing agentic workflows to process complex, multi-step queries autonomously.
items: - Designed a supervisor-worker agent model utilizing **LangChain** and **PostgreSQL Vector** databases for efficient memory management and context retrieval.

- Implemented Session-in-Disk strategies and robust asynchronous processing, enforcing strict **Cancellation Tokens** for task control to ensure system stability during extensive AI processing cycles.

skills.description: **.NET Core**, **Angular**, React, **Node.js**, Prisma, Vue 3, Vite, FastAPI, LangChain
**Microservices Architecture**, Agentic Workflows, SOLID principles, RESTful API Design, System Integration, IoT Development

coverLetter.openingParagraph: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Software Engineer position at Nexus Tech Global. With a solid foundation in Information Technology and hands-on experience building scalable web solutions, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your engineering team's success.
bodyParagraphs: During my tenure at PRIMAS CO. LTD, I played a key role in developing and optimizing backend functionalities for a large-scale CRM/CMS enterprise platform. I successfully integrated RabbitMQ message queues to offload heavy background tasks, which significantly enhanced system responsiveness and scalability. Furthermore, my proficiency with C#, .NET Core, Node.js, and Angular enabled me to build robust, high-performance features that reduced synchronization delays and ensured strict data validation.

At ALGORIT LAB, I designed and standardized RESTful services using Node.js and Prisma, facilitating seamless integration across distributed systems. I am highly passionate about microservices architecture and clean code principles. I look forward to bringing my technical capabilities and problem-solving skills to Nexus Tech Global's upcoming fintech initiatives.
coverLetter.closingParagraph: I welcome the opportunity to discuss further how my technical experience and proactive problem-solving approach can help Nexus Tech Global achieve its upcoming engineering milestones. Thank you for your time and consideration.
